primary_object_card.object_statement: A refuse-to-reuse matched-budget carrier tournament on the exact 64-object additive-XOR six-view senses_v2 world that compares a noncompetitive exact-likelihood oracle with four per-episode-memory lanes: a fair classical FST/HMM, a Torch GRU, the unchanged senses_v2 rho_fast-plus-m_slow anchor, and a product single-qubit-per-stage density probe; the frozen charged fitted-parameter capacity is the anchor actual 1038 live-DOF count, and every competitor must be within plus or minus 10 percent while the oracle is exempt; product updates use outcome-conditioned CPTP Kraus instruments with renormalization and per-update physicality assertions; all lanes otherwise preserve the common data, readout, metrics, controls, and frozen nonminimality verdict, with promotion always forbidden.

source_anchors.reference: current user directive: Carrier tournament v1
source_anchors.quote_or_summary: Build five named lanes on the senses_v2 world, with the oracle excluded from competition, matched budgets, referee controls, pairwise complementarity, and the frozen verdict.
The v0.1 amendment freezes occluded-object perception and the rule that a matched classical success kills carrier minimality; even a carrier win remains promotion-ineligible.

Defines the exact senses_v2 world recovery, object split, masked slots, rho_fast-plus-m_slow episode, readout, bootstrap, MI null, reset port, and frozen-readout port that lane 4 must reuse unchanged.
Diagnostic anchor receipt reports held-out occluded belief and records a red leak sentinel; it is input evidence, not a tournament result.
Referees require fair sequential classical lanes and a channel-overfit exclusion.

primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: The tournament asks whether the senses_v2 quantum-readout-fed carrier is minimally needed for cross-view hidden-bit belief once fair sequential classical and product-density carriers receive the same episodes, state/readout width, charged parameter budget, fitting data, and evaluation protocol. The exact-likelihood oracle only sets the reachable ceiling. A classical match within the object-bootstrap confidence interval records nonminimality. A carrier win can only be a bounded working-sim result and can never promote.

native_terms.belief carrier: The per-episode state retained while the six views of one object are processed and reset before the next object.
native_terms.matched budget: A machine-checked fail-closed ledger whose frozen charged active-carrier capacity is the anchor's 1038 live-DOF count; HMM/FST, GRU, and product competitors each need an auditable active fitted-parameter count within plus or minus 10 percent, while the common readout is reported separately and the oracle is exempt.
native_terms.oracle: An exact predictive-state Bayesian filter over the public additive-XOR hypotheses using the exact masked measurement likelihoods; it is a ceiling reference and is excluded from winner or minimality comparisons.
native_terms.anchor: The existing senses_v2 QuantumReadoutBayes episode and joint feature path, imported from source rather than reimplemented; its actual 4x4 fast density is recorded even though the owner request used three-qubit shorthand.
native_terms.channel scramble: A position permutation of the fitted emission-channel ownership, fixed without test labels and applied at evaluation; the observed effect is recorded without forcing a desired direction.
native_terms.within CI match: A classical lane is a match when its paired object-bootstrap accuracy difference against the anchor has a 95 percent interval whose upper/lower relation does not establish an anchor advantage; exact decision logic is frozen in source before the run.

weirdness_signature: The strongest reference is an oracle that is explicitly not allowed to win the tournament.
Minimality is falsified by a fair classical tie within uncertainty, not only by a strict classical point-estimate win.
The anchor is reused exactly even where its source-level carrier dimension conflicts with informal shorthand.
Channel scrambling is a diagnostic whose result is retained whichever way it lands.
All lanes remember within an episode and reset across object identities.
A positive carrier result remains promotion_allowed false.

primary_object_card.adapter_policy: The FST/HMM, GRU, and product-density lanes are typed comparison probes of episode memory, not replacements for the belief object. The oracle is a ceiling adapter. None can promote from analogy, label, or point estimate alone.
promotion_locks: a quantum-carrier win is limited to working-sim ceiling
a classical match or win records that the anchor has not earned minimal status
a failed fairness or integrity check blocks scientific interpretation

reuse or overwrite of the tournament result directory

loop_contract.repair_rule: Repair the first source, split, target-leakage, fairness-ledger, runtime, or receipt-integrity failure before interpreting any lane metric.
loop_contract.stop_condition: One fresh refuse-to-reuse result directory contains a complete receipt, or execution stops at a named memory, runtime, source, fairness, or integrity blocker.

method_contracts.question_is_not_authorization: A question is not authorization; this request explicitly authorizes only the named tournament build and run without deletion, movement, reuse, commit, promotion, or adjacent carrier expansion.
method_contracts.order_check_separate: Check execution order separately from content correctness: validate this current-task card and source locks, freeze budget and verdict logic, build, run under the canonical interpreter, and audit the fresh receipt in that order; the order witness is recorded in receipt checks.
method_contracts.baseline_preservation: While debugging the runtime path, preserve the tuned visible and output baseline: the exact senses_v2 world, split, masks, anchor episode, target, controls, metric definitions, and visible receipt contract remain unchanged while only the new tournament lanes and fair comparison ledger are added.
method_contracts.falsifier_first: Target claim: the anchor is minimally needed under matched budgets. Strongest live falsifier: any matched fair classical sequential lane matches or beats the anchor within the paired object-bootstrap interval. Decisive check: the frozen paired object-bootstrap rule after all fairness gates. Classify the target as killed, open, or survived before agreement or synthesis.
method_contracts.feynman_testability: Operation: update each lane state sequentially from the same six masked views, then decode the same held-out hidden bits. Observable: paired held-out accuracy, mutual information against a null, pairwise correctness cells, oracle gap, and control deltas. Pass/fail condition: the frozen source rule decides minimality and fairness gates can only block, never rescue, the anchor.
method_contracts.synthesis_refusal: Refuse to merge oracle ceiling with competitor evidence, a point-estimate lead with an uncertainty-resolved win, or a working-sim carrier result with promotion.
method_contracts.human_offload: Resolve source, runtime, budget, split, metric, and leakage questions with local code and receipts before asking the owner.
